concept_uz: Boʻlishdan butun boʻlmagan sonlar tugʻiladi — Nisbat xalqi. Qirol kasr chizigʻidan qoʻrqadi: «Umrbod shu chiziqning kasriga qoldim-a». 7 ÷ 3 dagi Uch mikrofonni qoʻymay «uch, uch, uch…» deydi — takrorlangani uchun 2,(3) deb yoziladi. Oxirida hamma butun son ham kasr boʻlib chiqadi: 5 = 5/1.
style_line: Premium 3D animated feature film style, gentle split light — cool moonlight from the left, warm sunlight from the right — soft shadows, rich colours, vertical 9:16. No text, no captions, no letters or numerals written anywhere, no watermark.

refs.prompt: Vertical 9:16 full-body character portrait. A round king shaped like a thick, chunky upright ring with a small hole in the middle, so its wide front face is a disc. The ring is coloured like a yin-yang: the left half dark moon-silver with one small bright gold dot, the right half bright sun-gold with one small dark silver dot, the two halves curving into each other in a smooth S-shaped wave — made of polished metal, not a flat printed symbol. Big kind expressive eyes and a small mouth on the front of the ring, thin cartoon arms and legs, a small jewelled crown tilted to the left, holding a long plain wooden staff. He stands in the middle of a vast low-poly crystal plain, exactly where the cool left side meets the warm right side, front view, centred.

Vertical 9:16 full-body character portrait. A slim upright sun-gold character shaped like a tall narrow pillar with a small slanted flag-like tip at the top, big cheerful eyes, a wide smile, thin cartoon arms and legs, and a small round badge with a plus sign pinned on its chest. It stands on the vast low-poly crystal plain, front view, centred.

Change this character: exactly the same shape, size and face, but made of shining moon-silver instead of gold, eyebrows lowered in a grumpy frown, arms crossed, and a horizontal dark-blue sash wrapped across its middle instead of the plus badge. Same plain, same framing, full body, front view.

Vertical 9:16 wide landscape. A vast empty low-poly crystal plain made of smooth faceted triangular polygons: cool lavender-blue facets on the left, warm amber facets on the right, blending softly in the middle. A thin glowing straight path runs across the ground from left to right through the centre. The sky is split the same gentle way: soft twilight indigo with a few stars on the left, where a pale moon with a gentle old woman's face smiles; warm morning light on the right, where a big warm sun with a kind old grandfather's face — smiling eyes, bushy eyebrows and a beard of rays — smiles back. Not dark, just a gentle difference between the two sides. No characters.

Vertical 9:16 full-body character portrait. A chubby, energetic purple character shaped like a curvy rounded number-three shape with two bulges, big excited eyes, open mouth mid-speech, wearing a shiny wedding-host jacket and holding a golden microphone. Crystal plain with festive lanterns, front view, centred.

Two gold characters on the low-poly crystal plain: one standing on top of a long glowing horizontal golden bar, the other standing beneath it, both proud, like a living fraction. Keep the character design the same. Vertical 9:16.

scenes.prompt: A gold character splits itself into two groups; three and a half small pieces of light appear — one of them only half the size. Everyone gasps. The character says in Uzbek with an astonished young voice: "Uch butun… va yarim?!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

The two characters on and under the glowing bar strike a proud pose and together says in Uzbek with several proud young voices speaking in unison: "Biz ikki butun sonning nisbatidan yaralganmiz!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Biz ikki butun sonning nisbatidan yaralganmiz!

scenes.prompt: The ring-king sees the glowing bar, shudders, and steps back as if it might bite. He mutters to himself, says in Uzbek with a warm, slightly dramatic middle-aged male voice: "Umrbod shu chiziqning kasriga qoldim-a." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

The purple character with the microphone talks non-stop; behind it the sun sets and rises again in a time-lapse while it keeps going: it says in Uzbek with a fast, loud wedding-host man's voice: "Uch, uch, uch, uch, uch, uch…" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Uch, uch, uch, uch, uch, uch…

scenes.prompt: The silver character covers its ears in agony while the purple character keeps talking into the microphone; it says in Uzbek with a slightly croaky, grumpy young boy's voice: "Kimdir mikrofonni olsin!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

The ring-king gently takes the microphone, smiles, and says in Uzbek with a warm, slightly dramatic middle-aged male voice: "Xo'p. Ikki butun, qavs ichida uch. Bas!" The purple character finally falls silent, then grins happily. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Xoʻp. Ikki butun, qavs ichida uch. Bas!

scenes.prompt: The fraction folk place a gold character on top of the glowing bar and a single slim one-character beneath it, then turn to the king triumphantly; one of them says in Uzbek with several proud young voices speaking in unison: "Besh — bu besh bo'lu bir. Demak, siz ham bizdansiz!" The king's crown slips. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Besh — bu besh boʻlu bir. Demak, siz ham bizdansiz!

scenes.prompt: A grand ceremony on the plain: everyone cheers as the ring-king is honoured as ruler of the fraction kingdom, confetti of light falling. Then the camera slowly drifts away to a dark, quiet gap in the ground. An off-screen narrator says in Uzbek with a warm storyteller's male voice: "Ammo bitta lekin bor edi… Davomi — powerty.uz da." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Ammo bitta lekin bor edi… Davomi — powerty.uz da.
